newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: First Gas eyes six banks to fund Siemens deal.
newsitem.headline: First Gas eyes six banks to fund Siemens deal.

text.p: The Philippines' First Gas Holdings Corp said it was holding talks with six foreign banks to finance construction of a $650 million power plant it planned to build jointly with Siemens A.G. of Germany.
First Gas president Peter Garrucho told reporters on Wednesday the talks were in an exploratory stage and First Gas hoped to finalise the financial package before the end of the year.
First Gas, a joint venture of British Gas and First Philippine Holdings Corp, and Siemens planned to build the 990-megawatt gas-fired power plant in nearby Batangas province, Garrucho said.
He said the deal with Siemens would be signed in October to coincide with the Manila visit of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl.

Garrucho identified the banks as Hermes and KFW (Kreditanstalt Fur Wiederaufbau) of Germany, the United States Export-Import Bank, the Malaysian Export Credit Bank, the Brussels-based European Investments Bank and Commonwealth Development Corp of Britain.
